description: This script configures iOS signing settings by determining team IDs, bundle identifiers, and signing profiles. It generates a local-only configuration file for iOS app signing.

methods.name: sanitize_identifier_segment
methods.description: Sanitizes a string to be a valid identifier segment, converting to lowercase and replacing invalid characters with hyphens.

methods.name: normalize_bundle_id
methods.description: Normalizes a bundle ID string, converting to lowercase and replacing invalid characters with hyphens, then trimming.
